firstContext: The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
🗣️ Luis to Hank, by the fire: "29 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A man, maybe 20s is back with Simone.
